corePassives.description:
State Switching 
 Fully-Hollowed Ichigo has two states: Obsession State and Ferocity State. He starts in Obsession State. The appearance of his Spiritual Pressure Bar indicates his current state. 
 Releasing the final hit of his Basic Attack activates a Special Attack or Special Technique, depending on his  current state. At full Spiritual Pressure, these attacks become enhanced. Using an Enhanced Special attack or Enhanced Special Technique switches him to the other state. 
 When Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo switches in from the backjline, he immediately uses one of the following skills according to the priority below: 
 1. Upon reaching 4 Void Points, immediately releases the Enhanced Ultimate - Cero of Destruction. 
 2. At max Spiritual Pressure, immediately uses the enhanced skill conrresponding to his current state, then switches states. 
 3. While Brutal is active, immediately releases the 5th hit of his Basic Attack - Berserk Strike. 
 4. Otherwise, he releases the Dodge Attack - Fierce Pierce. 
 Full Hollowfication 
 Increases his resistance to interruption. Gains Hollowfication Levels based on his Max HP: For the portion of Max HP up to 18,800, every 25 HP grants 1 Hollowfication Level. For the portion above 18,000, every 5 HP grants 1 Hollowfication Level. 
 At the start of battle, each Hollowfication Level grants 1 ATK. 
 Dissipation and Destruction 
 When any Ultimate hits an enemy in Spiritual Pressure Dissipation or without a Spiritual Pressure Bar, it triggers Destruction, increasing the damage multiplier of that hit by 20%.

skills.description:
Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo launches a swift, savage assault, dealing a total damage equal to 1142.5% of ATK over 6 hits while accumulating Spiritual Pressure. 
 The final hit activates the Special Technique - Intimidating Howl or Special Attack - Cero Blast, according to his current state. ~~Savage Combo~~ Tap and hold Basic Attack 
 Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo leaps into the air and launches an even more savage assault, dealing a total damage equal to 1480% of ATK over 6 hits while accumulating Spiritual Pressure. 
 The final hit activates the Special Technique - Intimidating Howl or Special Attack - Cero Blast, according to his current state. ~~Cero Blast~~ While in Ferocity, tap and hold Basic Attack after releasing the final hit of Basic Attack 
 Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo leaps into the air and fires a Cero at enemies, dealing damage equalt o 1720% of ATK and building a large amount of Spiritual Pressure. ~~Cero Roar~~ While in Obsession, tap and hold Basic Attack when Spiritual Pressure is full 
 Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo roars, then leaps into the air and fires a Cero at enemies, dealing damage equal to 2675.5% of ATK. He then gains 1 Void Point and switches to Ferocity. 
 Tap Basic Attack afterward to immediately follow up with the 4th hit of the Basic Attack - Savage Combo. 
 This skill counts as an Enhanced Cero skill.
skills.name: Berserk Strike

skills.description:
Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo leaps toward enemies and rams into them, then delivers an overpowering downward claw strike, dealing damage equal to 1392.5% of ATK. He then gains Brutal. ~~Intimidating Howl~~ While in Obsession, tap Technique after releasing the final hit of the Basic Attack 
 Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo unleashes and intimidating howl, knocking back and terrifying nearby enemies, dealing damage equal to 1192.5% of ATK and building a large amount of Spiritual Pressure. ~~Cero of Intimidation~~ While in Ferocity, tap Technique when Spiritual Pressure is full 
 Fully Hollowfied Ichigo howls, then fires a Cero at enemies, dealing damage equal to 2680% of ATK. He then gains 1 Void Point and switches to Obsession. 
 This skill counts as an Enhanced Cero skill.
skills.name: Suppressive Claw

skills.description:
Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo pins an enemy beneath his foot and fires a Cero capable of shattering the void, dealing damage equal to 3367.5% of ATK. He then gains 1 Void Point. 
 This skill counts as an Enhanced Cero skill. ~~Cero of Destruction~~ With 4 Void Points, tap Technique or Ultimate, or tap and hold Bsic Attack 
 Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo leaps high into the air and fires a powerful, destructive Cero at enemies, dealing damage equal to 5455% of ATK. 
 This skill counts as an Enhanced Cero skill.
skills.name: Cero if Ruin

skills.description:
Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo swings downward with brute force, dealing damage equal to 45% of ATK and allowing him to counter an enemy's Spiritual Pressure attack. 
 If successful, tap Basic Attack to follow up with a counterattack. Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo quickly overpowers the enemy, then drags and slams them, dealing damage equal to 1765% of ATK. Gains Brutal upon successfully countering an enemy's Spiritual Pressure attack. ~~Counter~~ Sucecssfully perform a Counter during the Basic Attack - Savage Combo or any Special Attack, then tap Basic Attack 
 After blocking an enemy's attack, Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo overpowers them, then drags and brutally slams them, dealing damage equal to 1765% of ATK. 
 Tap Basic Attack afterwards to immediately follow up with the 4th hit of his Basic Attack - Savage Combo.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
Use Sonido to avoid attacks right before they hit. 
 Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Fully-Hollowfied Ichigo gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds. 
 Tap and hold the Dodge button to charge. Release it to perform a different follow-up attack depending on whether the charge is complete. Taking a hit while charging instantly completes the charge. ~~Fierce Pierce~~ Release Dodge before charging is complete 
 While charging, Ichigo dodges backward, then thrusts forward, dealing damage equal to 42.5% of ATK. 
 Tap Basic Attack afterward to immediately follow up with the 2nd hit of his Basic Attack - Berserk Strike. 
 This attack counts as a basic attack. ~~Charged Slash~~ Release Dodge once charging is complete 
 Once fully charged, Ichigo rushes at enemies and unleashes a barrage of powerful slashes, dealing damage equal to 145% of ATK. 
 Tap Basic Attack afterward to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of his Basic Attack - Berserk  Strike. 
 This attack counts as a Special Attack.
skills.name: Sonido
